description: This file contains Google Test unit tests for the TextToSpeech plugin, testing various functionalities such as enable/disable TTS, get API version, list voices, speak, pause, resume, set/get configuration, and ACL management within the TextToSpeech plugin implementation.

classes.name: TTSTest
classes.description: Base test fixture class managing plugin, handler, connection, and worker pool.

classes.name: TTSInitializedTest
classes.description: Derived test fixture that initializes mocks and plugin components, setting up the environment for TTS plugin testing.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods
methods.description: Test that verifies the plugin successfully registers core methods on initialization.

methods.name: EnableTTSDefault
methods.description: Test that enabling TTS with string true works and response contains TTS status and success.

methods.name: EnableTTSTrue
methods.description: Test enabling TTS with boolean true and verifying that isttsenabled is true.

methods.name: EnableTTSFalse
methods.description: Test disabling TTS with boolean false and verifying that isttsenabled is false.

methods.name: GetAPIVersion
methods.description: Test retrieving the API version from the plugin.

methods.name: IsTTSEnabledDefault
methods.description: Test default state of TTS enabled flag (should be false).

methods.name: IsListVoicesEmpty
methods.description: Test listing voices with default (empty) response.

methods.name: ListVoicesSetEmptyLanguage
methods.description: Test listvoices with empty string language, expecting success.

methods.name: ListVoicesSetWhiteSpaceAsLanguage
methods.description: Test listvoices with whitespace language, expecting error.

methods.name: ListVoicesSetNumberAsLanguage
methods.description: Test listvoices with numeric language, expecting error.

methods.name: ListVoicesSetNullLanguage
methods.description: Test listvoices with null language, expecting error.

methods.name: Speak
methods.description: Test the speak method converting text to speech with valid configuration.

methods.name: IsSpeaking
methods.description: Test retrieving speaking status with a speechid.

methods.name: IsSpeakingEmptySpeechId

methods.name: IsSpeakingStringAsSpeechId

methods.name: CancelStringAsSpeechId

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Test pause with a speechid, expecting error.
